_note: Axis-A color round-trip baseline (measured 2026-06-03, real WebView2). 709-limited round-trips faithfully (app-only worst_app_max=0). BT.601 and full-range sources are a KNOWN BUG: getDecoderConfig() yields no colorSpace for these files, so withDefaultColorSpace defaults every HD source to bt709/limited and the decoder is fed the wrong matrix/range. For known-bad encodings expectFaithful=false; the gate asserts the bug is STILL present (worst_app_max > faithfulMax) and turns RED when the color-management fix lands -> flip expectFaithful:true then. measured_worst_app_max is documentation, NOT a gate threshold.
